data.text:
DAMAC Islands by DAMAC Properties in Dubai is an ambitious waterfront development that embodies the perfect blend of coastal serenity and urban sophistication. Located adjacent to Sun City, this master-planned community offers a luxurious lifestyle with exclusive residences, pristine beaches, crystal-clear lagoons, and world-class amenities. Designed to elevate waterfront living, this development promises a haven for those seeking both a dream home and an exceptional investment opportunity.

Let’s explore everything you need to know about the key features, lifestyle, and investment potential of DAMAC Islands, making it one of the most coveted residential projects in Dubai.

Luxury Waterfront Living by DAMAC Properties

DAMAC Properties is known for its premium developments, and DAMAC Islands stands out as a flagship project, offering waterfront living at its finest. Residents will be able to enjoy stunning views of the sea, private beaches, and serene lagoons, coupled with modern urban conveniences. Whether you’re looking for a primary residence or a vacation home, DAMAC Islands promises an unparalleled lifestyle that blends natural beauty with luxury.

It offers 4 and 5-bedroom townhouses and 5, 6 and 7-bedroom villas, thoughtfully designed to deliver a truly luxurious lifestyle. Each residence within the community will be meticulously designed to offer comfort, elegance, and exclusivity, featuring contemporary architecture and spacious layouts. From infinity pools to world-class marinas, every detail will provide a resort-like experience, making it a top choice for those seeking luxury waterfront living by DAMAC Properties.

DAMAC Islands benefits from a prestigious location right next to Sun City in Dubailand, making it easily accessible to Dubai’s key urban hubs. Residents of this upcoming project in Dubai will enjoy seamless connectivity to the city while living in a peaceful, waterfront retreat. The community is strategically situated to offer proximity to renowned landmarks, entertainment venues, shopping malls, and healthcare facilities.

The location also ensures easy access to Dubai’s coastal attractions, with several beaches, marinas, and yacht clubs nearby. Whether you prefer a tranquil seaside escape or vibrant city life, DAMAC Islands offers the best of both worlds.

Community Living

DAMAC Islands fosters a sense of community with thoughtfully designed spaces and amenities that promote interaction and well-being. The development will offer a variety of facilities that encourage an active lifestyle, including:

  • Cycling and jogging tracks winding through scenic landscapes.
  • State-of-the-art fitness centers equipped with the latest amenities.
  • Indoor and outdoor recreational spaces for family activities.

The community’s family-friendly environment, combined with world-class infrastructure, makes it an ideal location for families, professionals, and retirees in Dubai. With easy access to schools, clinics, and retail outlets, community living in DAMAC Islands is both convenient and enjoyable.

Amenities in DAMAC Islands

DAMAC Islands offers an exceptional range of amenities, carefully curated to provide residents with a luxurious and vibrant lifestyle. From thrilling outdoor activities to serene wellness experiences, the community ensures there is something for everyone. Whether it’s enjoying nature, relaxing at a spa, or engaging in adventurous water sports, DAMAC Islands promises an enriching living experience. Here’s an exclusive look at the many amenities residents will get to enjoy in this upcoming community.

  • Aqua Dome & Park – A unique water-themed attraction perfect for family fun.
  • Iguanas Park & Fruit Market – A tropical park with exotic wildlife and fresh produce markets.
  • Jungle River – A scenic river that meanders through lush greenery, ideal for relaxation.
  • Hot Spring SPA – A luxurious spa experience with therapeutic hot springs.
  • Kayaking & Paddle Boarding – Water activities for those seeking adventure on the lagoons.
  • Zipline – A thrilling ride offering panoramic views of the community.

faqs.question: What type of residential units will be available on DAMAC Island?

data.answer: DAMAC Islands will feature a range of luxurious townhouses and villas, designed to offer residents an exclusive waterfront living experience. There will be more than 471 units for buyers to choose from. These residential units come in spacious 4, 5, 6, and 7-bedroom configurations, ideal for families seeking a blend of modern design and coastal charm. Each unit is crafted with contemporary architecture, featuring large open spaces, floor-to-ceiling windows, and premium finishes to enhance natural light and provide breathtaking views of the Arabian Gulf.

faqs.question: When will DAMAC Islands be completed?

data.answer: The completion and handover of DAMAC Islands are scheduled for December 2029. This timeline allows investors and homebuyers ample opportunity to secure a property in this exclusive waterfront development, with flexible payment plans available throughout the construction phase.
